The mountains answer, and the sound drifts afar
A gentle echo circles the earth
Proclaiming the good news of Christ’s birth
Glory, glory, glory to the true God
Glory to the true God
Glory, glory, glory to the true God
Glory to God Most High

Why do they sing songs of glory without ceasing?

The glad news that the Savior is born
Glory, glory, glory to the true God
Glory to the true God
Glory, glory, glory to the true God
Glory to God Most High

Kneel in worship before the Lord Jesus
Sing aloud that the Savior is born
